snippet.title: Apple Killed It! 🤯
snippet.description:
iPhone Duo Features Apple Didn’t Tell You! (Foldable iPhone)

The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable iPhone. It has a wide-ish glossy outer screen and a larger inner display with a matte finish, so there are no reflections and the crease is barely visible. The unfolding animation plays on both the outer and the inner screens, and the hinge holds at any angle you stop it.

The iPhone Duo is rated IP68 despite the folding design. We dropped it in water during, and it continued to work normally.

The Dock and the Dynamic Island are now vertical, which is perfect for right handed use. For the first time on an iPhone, you can run two apps at once, side by side, and drag and drop content between them. A small bubble shows the Wi-Fi connection, battery level and network strength.

Apple has also built apps specifically for the Duo. The music player lets you change tracks on the open screen, and when you close the phone, you can play, pause and rewind, similar to a Walkman.

StandBy mode works without connecting a charger, unlike other iPhones. It works in vertical orientation as well as horizontal, and a glow appears on the table when the morning alarm rings.

The Duo is powered by the A20 Pro and has a 4833mAh battery, which easily lasts a full day. The camera system has two 48MP cameras. When you photograph someone, you can show them a live preview on the outer screen. And there's this feature called Smart Take, that automatically captures your candid photos.

Face ID has been removed, and Touch ID has returned as the biometric unlock.

This is everything you needed to know about the all new iPhone Duo!
